title: Bloomveil MC
description: Welcome to Bloomveil MC, a refined Survival world, where all journeys start among the cherry blossoms. Experience a player-based economy system, Jobs, AuraSkills, GriefPrevention plots, BetterTeams, auctions, custom crates, events, and full Java & Bedrock
body: Welcome to **Bloomveil MC**, a refined Survival world, where all journeys start among the cherry blossoms. Experience a player-based economy system, Jobs, AuraSkills, GriefPrevention plots, BetterTeams, auctions, custom crates, events, and full Java & Bedrock cross-play. If you want to build your own kingdom, explore the wild, or make new friends, there is always something for you at Bloomveil MC.
